claims: A U.S. visa is an official authorization placed in a passport allowing foreign citizens to enter the United States for specific purposes (tourism, study, work).
U.S. visa requirements include a valid passport.
U.S. visa requirements include application form DS-160.
U.S. visa requirements include a photo.
U.S. visa requirements include an interview.
U.S. visa applications are made through the U.S. Embassy or Consulate.
U.S. visa fees vary by type.
Visas are categorized by the reason for travel.
Nonimmigrant visa requirements include a passport valid for travel.
Nonimmigrant visa requirements include documentation supporting the purpose of the trip.
Nonimmigrant visa application fees generally range from $185 to $315 depending on the visa category.
Nonimmigrant visa application fees are nonrefundable.
Nonimmigrant visas have possible issuance fees afterward.
Visa Waiver Program (ESTA) allows citizens from participating countries to travel for tourism/business for up to 90 days without a visa.
Student visas require leaving within 60 days of program completion.
Other visas have specific expiration dates.
